notes: The UNO R4 WiFi is not in the catalogue; the catalogue's arduino-uno (R3) is used because it has the same header port names (A0, A5, 5V, GND.1). A0 is the DAC output on the R4.

The breadboard in the image is flipped vertically relative to the catalogue: the bottom half of the image (rows a-e) is bank 't', the top half (rows f-j) is bank 'b'. The rails at the bottom of the image are therefore tp/tn: the top rail line (black) is tn, the lower (red) is tp.
Rail hole indices (tp.2, tn.1, tp.11, tn.12, tn.25) and column numbers are estimated from the image pixel positions.

Potentiometer: outer legs at columns 13 (to +5V) and 15 (to GND); the wiper (middle) pin points to the other bank at column 14 and is joined by the yellow wire to A5. Which outer leg is VCC vs GND is symmetric.
Buzzer legs at columns 26 and 30; column 26 goes to A0 (DAC), column 30 goes to GND through a black jumper. Leg 1 is taken as the positive leg.
The pot wiper goes to A5 (analog input) and is read by the sketch to change the frequency; the code is not part of the graph.
